scope: Sixteen conservative ordinary stage-advancing additions for the current Digivice graph. No source/core/artwork mutations; upstream game-authored routes are not franchise canon claims.

source.method: Read-only git show/rev-parse, Python standard-library JSON parsing, and local graph comparison. No upstream imports, dependencies, scripts, runtime, GUI, or network requests.

interpretation.authoritativeForwardData: database/base-digimon-list.json digiEvolutionSeedList. A source row evolutionRequirements applies to every outgoing target; no row uses explicit route objects.
interpretation.levelSemantics: DigiGame resets level to 1 and experience to 0 after evolution; the local game retains progression. Raw source thresholds are recorded as evidence only. No reset/clamp is proposed.
interpretation.sameStageAndModes: There are zero same-rank ordinary forward edges in the upstream base. All 16 proposed edges strictly advance our current stage. Missing modes are not stage gaps; Imperialdramon modes are separate fusion recipes in upstream.
interpretation.displayGraphWarning: The upstream display graph adds reversed degeneration links and deduplicates undirected pairs. Its Gigimon→Growlmon appearance is not a forward route: actual forward source is Guilmon, while Growlmon lists Gigimon for degeneration.
interpretation.fusionAndArmor: Fusion is a separate multi-instance system. Current base Armor names are ordinary level-only routes with upstream Ultimate rank; no source Digimental/item gate should be invented or silently imported.
interpretation.matchingPolicy: Only exact name equality after lowercase/punctuation/space normalization is used for these edges. Variant suffixes are never removed. Manual aliases, Dot-to-base substitution, Chronomon Holy/Destroy and Daemon/Creepymon collapse are excluded.
